note: Official warning feeds the hourly job reads. Each run records whether a feed worked, so the page shows which ones are live. Add a feed here when an agency publishes RSS, Atom or CAP; JSON feeds need an adapter in tools/refresh_warnings.mjs ('type'). match: optional regex an item must contain to be kept (for a feed that covers a wider area). CAP feeds from cap-sources.s3.amazonaws.com (the IFRC/WMO alert hub's public copy of each agency's CAP feed) were checked from GitHub on 2026-09-27 and again on 2026-10-01: only agencies with an alert in the last 12 months are listed, and only alerts from the last 7 days are shown.
